value: Onarheim, K., Santos, S., Kangas, P. and Hankalin, V. (2017). Performance and costs of CCS in the pulp and paper industry part 1: Performance of amine-based post-combustion CO2 capture. International Journal of Greenhouse Gas Control 59, 58-73. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijggc.2017.02.008

Part 1 (performance) only; Part 2 (costs) is loaded as onarheim_2017_002. Loaded for the three single-source capture cases of the market pulp mill (2A-1 recovery boiler, 2A-2 multi-fuel boiler, 2A-3 lime kiln): design capture rate, CO2 captured per year (Table 5) and, per t CO2, capture-plant electricity and steam derived from Table 8 with the 8400 operating hours per year printed in Part 2 (p.62). Not loaded: the combined-source cases and the integrated-mill cases (same capture plant, mill-specific steam balances), water use (Table 7), the reference-mill energy balance (Table 3).
(1) Operating hours are not printed in Part 1; the 8400 h/yr of Part 2 are used (the Part 1 base-case export implies 8425 h). (2) Steam is given in t/h, not energy.
